premises.text: ThriftDB simplifies the search infrastructure by combining the database, search index, and web server into one system
premises.evidence_span: ThriftDB is just combining the database, the search index, and the web server into one system.

premises.text: Companies model their data in terms of objects with attributes
premises.evidence_span: companies view the world in terms of objects. Objects are just data items with attributes.

premises.text: ThriftDB handles objects natively, allowing users to input and search for objects
premises.evidence_span: With ThriftDB, you put in objects. You get objects back. You search across them.

premises.text: ThriftDB provides fast, scalable search capabilities out of the box
premises.evidence_span: With ThriftDB, you get fast, scalable search right out of the box.

premises.text: ThriftDB allows for flexible schema updates without downtime
premises.evidence_span: Now we just upload a new schema, and that's it.

value.text: Search becomes simpler and more efficient for users through ThriftDB
value.evidence_span: It's a really powerful tool that's also extremely simple to use.
